name: work-ticket
title: DRAFT: Driver work ticket
for_each: select id,code from movements where booking_id in (select id from bookings where status='confirmed')

sections.title: Journey
sections.note: UTC times. Check local time, pickup instructions and route before issue. This document is not dispatch clearance.

name: confirmation
title: DRAFT: Charter confirmation
for_each: select id,code from bookings where status in ('confirmed','quote')

sections.title: Client and agreed amount
sections.sql: select b.code,b.name,c.name customer,b.status,b.currency,b.amount_cents,b.notes from bookings b join customers c on c.id=b.customer_id where b.id=$1

sections.title: Movements
sections.note: Confirm local times and tax treatment before sending. Nothing sends from this project.
sections.sql: select code,starts_at,ends_at,pickup,destination,passengers from movements where booking_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Recorded invoices
sections.note: A reconciliation draft, not a tax invoice or payment request.
sections.sql: select i.code,b.currency,i.issued_on,i.due_on,i.amount_cents,i.paid_cents,i.amount_cents-i.paid_cents balance_cents from invoices i join bookings b on b.id=i.booking_id where b.customer_id=$1 order by i.due_on

name: contract-review
title: DRAFT: School and charter contract review

sections.title: Recorded bookings
sections.sql: select code,name,status,currency,amount_cents from bookings where contract_id=$1 order by code
